# Psalm 75 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 75:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** To-the-choirmaster. Do-not-destroy. A-psalm of-Asaph. A-song. We-give-thanks to-you O-God, we-give-thanks, and-near your-name; they-recount your-wondrous-deeds.
- **LOGOS:** To the choirmaster: according to Do Not Destroy. A Psalm of Asaph. A Song. We give thanks to you, O God; we give thanks, for your name is near. We recount your wondrous deeds.
- **PNEUMA:** For the choir director: to the tune of 'Do Not Destroy.' A psalm of Asaph. A song. We thank you, God — oh, we thank you! Your name is near, and people can't stop talking about your amazing works.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 75:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-said to-the-boasters, 'Do-not boast,' and-to-the-wicked, 'Do-not lift-up the-horn.'
- **LOGOS:** I say to the boastful, 'Do not boast,' and to the wicked, 'Do not lift up your horn.
- **PNEUMA:** 'I tell the proud: Stop your bragging! I tell the wicked: Don't flex your power.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 75:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For not from-east and-not from-west, and-not from-wilderness exaltation.
- **LOGOS:** For not from the east or from the west and not from the wilderness comes lifting up,
- **PNEUMA:** Promotion doesn't come from the east or the west, and it doesn't come from the wilderness.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 75:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For a-cup in-hand-of YHWH, and-wine foams, full-of mixture, and-he-pours from-this; surely its-dregs they-drain they-drink, all the-wicked-of the-earth.
- **LOGOS:** For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup with foaming wine, well mixed, and he pours out from it, and all the wicked of the earth shall drain it down to the dregs.
- **PNEUMA:** The LORD holds a cup of foaming, spiced wine in his hand; he pours it out, and every wicked person on earth will drink it down to the last drop.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 75:10 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-all horns-of the-wicked I-will-cut-off; will-be-lifted-up the-horns-of the-righteous.
- **LOGOS:** All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
- **PNEUMA:** I will shatter the power of the wicked, but the strength of the righteous will be raised high.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 75:3 (overlap: 7%)

- **PNEUMA:** When the earth and everyone on it is shaking, I'm the one holding the pillars steady.' Selah
